sections.heading: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A cold front will cross the area tonight with a line of showers and thunderstorms, some of which could be severe. Much cooler air arrives Thursday.

sections.heading: NEAR TERM /THROUGH TONIGHT/
sections.text: Scattered storms are developing ahead of the front. Damaging winds and a few tornadoes are the main threats through 9 PM before storms exit east after midnight.

sections.heading: SHORT TERM /THURSDAY THROUGH FRIDAY/
sections.text: Gusty northwest winds and cooler temperatures follow the front. Highs on Thursday will only reach the lower 50s.

sections.heading: AVIATION /19Z WEDNESDAY THROUGH 18Z THURSDAY/
sections.text: Thunderstorms with brief IFR visibility are expected at all terminals between 21Z and 02Z, then MVFR ceilings improve to VFR by morning.
